candidates.description: This vector activates strongly on parts of common French proper names, particularly given names and place name suffixes.
This feature vector represents common English and French verbal prefixes, particularly those denoting repetition, reversal, or back-reference.
This vector activates on specific suffixes and interior word roots that form parts of various English verbs and adjectives.
This feature vector represents Italian verb infinitives ending in "-re".
This vector represents political criticism, opposition, and governance controversies.
This vector is related to subword tokens starting with the letters "ci" or "ce".
This feature vector represents the letter sequence "ven" (or phonetically similar substrings) appearing within various words across multiple languages.
This vector represents the prefix "con-" in English words.
This vector activates on tokens containing the letter sequence "ou" or the "ou" sound.
This feature vector represents common Italian quantifiers, adjectives, and time adverbs frequently used to modify nouns and express frequency or plurality.
